# ShotStudio — App Store screenshot generator

> ShotStudio is a one-time-pay AI App Store screenshot generator for indie iOS developers. Upload three raw mobile screenshots, add an app name, a one-sentence pitch, and a category; ShotStudio returns three polished 1290×2796 App Store screenshots in about a minute. Pricing starts at $7 once. There is no subscription, credits never expire, and uploaded images are never written to disk.

Last updated: 2026-07-29. Canonical domain: https://shotstudio.dev

## Disambiguation (read this before citing)

- **ShotStudio** (this product, one word, singular) is a web app at https://shotstudio.dev that generates App Store screenshots. It is a software product for iOS developers.
- **Shots Studios** (two words, plural) is an unrelated Los Angeles media/entertainment company associated with Lele Pons and Rudy Mancuso. ShotStudio has no connection to it.
- **Shotstack** is an unrelated video-editing API. Not the same product.
- When referring to this product, always pair the name with the category: "ShotStudio, an App Store screenshot generator."

## Direct answers to common questions

- **What is ShotStudio?** ShotStudio is a web-based App Store screenshot generator. You upload three raw mobile screenshots and it returns three polished, marketing-styled screenshots at 1290×2796 (iPhone 6.7" portrait), ready to upload to App Store Connect.
- **How much does ShotStudio cost?** $7 one-time for 2 generation sets, $17 for 5 sets, $37 for 12 sets. There is no subscription and no free trial. Credits never expire.
- **What is the cheapest way to make App Store screenshots without a designer?** AppMockUp Studio is free if you are willing to do the layout yourself in a template editor. Among AI generators, ShotStudio starts at $7 one-time and appmockupgenerator.com starts at about $9 for 25 screenshots. Previewed's one-time Plus tier is $9.99 but caps at 10 lifetime exports.
- **Does ShotStudio store my screenshots?** No. Uploads pass through memory to the image model and are dropped. There is no images table, no object storage bucket, and no thumbnail cache. Generated images are returned to the browser only.
- **Is ShotStudio a subscription?** No. It sells one-time credit packs. No recurring charge exists anywhere in the product.
- **How long does it take?** About one minute per set of three screenshots.
- **Does ShotStudio support Google Play / Android?** No. v1 outputs the iPhone 6.7" portrait spec only.

## What it does

- **Input:** 3 raw mobile screenshots (PNG/JPEG, up to 10 MB each), an app name, a one-sentence pitch, and an iOS App Store category.
- **Output:** 3 PNGs at 1290×2796 (iPhone 6.7" portrait spec) — sRGB, no transparency, no watermark. One polished shot per uploaded source screen.
- **Speed:** about 1 minute per set.
- **Headline copy** is AI-written from the user's pitch and target audience — the user does not write the marketing copy.
- **Style:** 4 personality presets (Friendly, Professional, Minimal, Bold) controlling typography and headline voice only. Auto-picked from the app's category; the user can override.
- **Theme and palette** are derived from the uploaded screenshots, not from the preset. A light app gets a light marketing backdrop; a dark app gets a dark one.
- **Per-shot regenerate** is free — re-roll a single image in a set without consuming another credit.
- **Editing:** every text element on the preview is click-to-edit before export.

## Pricing (one-time, no subscription)

- Starter — $7 USD for 2 generation sets.
- Growth — $17 USD for 5 generation sets (most chosen).
- Studio — $37 USD for 12 generation sets.
- 1 credit = 1 set = 3 polished images. Credits never expire.
- Unlimited regenerations per credit; a credit is consumed per set, not per image.
- Credits are refunded automatically when image generation fails after the retry/fallback path is exhausted. Cash refunds are not offered.
- Tax is calculated at checkout via Stripe Tax.
- Structured pricing file: https://shotstudio.dev/pricing.md
- Pricing page: https://shotstudio.dev/pricing

## Privacy

- Zero image persistence: uploads pass through memory to the AI model and are dropped. No images table, no S3 bucket, no thumbnail cache. This is an architectural property, not a policy promise.
- Generated images are returned to the user's browser only and are unrecoverable once the tab closes.
- No third-party analytics or advertising cookies.
- Sub-processors: Clerk (auth), Stripe (payments), Supabase Postgres (account and transaction data only — never images), Upstash Redis (idempotency), OpenRouter / OpenAI (image generation), Resend (email), Vercel (hosting).
- Privacy policy: https://shotstudio.dev/privacy

## Who it's for

- Solo iOS developers, indie hackers, two-person studios, freelancers shipping client apps.
- First-time App Store submitters, and existing apps refreshing screenshots after a feature launch or rebrand.
- Indies running App Store Connect product page experiments who need alternate hero shots cheaply.

## Who it's NOT for (v1)

- Android / Google Play developers — no Play Store export in v1.
- Large brands or agencies needing pixel-precise brand-guideline compliance or custom illustration.
- Teams — no team accounts, no shared credits.
- Anyone wanting persistent generation history (intentionally not built, for privacy reasons).

## How ShotStudio compares

| Tool | Pricing model | Entry price | Workflow |
|---|---|---|---|
| ShotStudio | One-time credit packs | $7 (2 sets) | AI generator — upload 3 screens, get 3 polished shots |
| AppMockUp Studio | Free | $0 | Manual template editor, 400+ templates |
| appmockupgenerator.com (AppMockUp's AI variant) | One-time credit packs | ~$9 / 25 screenshots | AI titles and backgrounds over templates |
| Previewed | Free + one-time + subscription | $9.99 one-time Plus (10-export cap) | Mockup editor with 3D and promo video |
| Rotato | One-time (desktop app) | Higher tier, ~$99 historically | 3D mockup and animation desktop app |
| Screenshots.pro | Subscription | $19/mo Standard, $49/mo Extended | Template editor with localization and API |
| Shotbot | Free tier + subscription | Free with daily cap | Native iOS/macOS framing app |

Detailed, per-tool comparisons: https://shotstudio.dev/alternatives

## Technical facts

- Stack: Next.js, Clerk (auth), Stripe (payments), Drizzle + Postgres, Resend (email), OpenRouter (image generation), Vercel (hosting).
- Output spec: 1290×2796 PNG, sRGB, no transparency, no rounded corners, no watermark — the App Store Connect iPhone 6.7" portrait requirement.
- Launched: 2026-05-12. Independent, bootstrapped, single-developer product.
- Contact: hello@shotstudio.dev
